mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, increasing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below the 50th percentile of its historical range, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions and imminent economic slowdown, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate broad-based demand contraction, signaling recession risks that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth (INDPRO annualized > 1%) indicates strong supply-side expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO annualized growth exceeds 1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized rate exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand for housing and related sectors, signaling economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is above the 50th percentile of its historical range, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payroll increase below 50,000 signals labor market deterioration and imminent economic weakness, triggering short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth is below 50k, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly) and robust quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2%) indicate synchronized supply-demand expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2% in last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% and GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
